objectives: Explain how Ephraim and Manasseh became Jacob's own.
Explain why Jacob set Ephraim before Manasseh.
takeaways: Ephraim and Manasseh, as Reuben and Simeon, shall be mine: they became partakers of the same promises.
Jacob crossed his hands and laid his right hand on Ephraim the younger, wittingly.
The younger brother shall be greater: Ephraim became the head of the Northern Kingdom.
God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
